notes.title: Bend gravity in puzzle-platformer Sky Beneath
notes.content: Narrative-driven puzzle platformer Sky Beneath showed up on Steam recently, aiming for a release this year, and has a free demo that's pretty promising. The indie by Mindhaven Games is narrative driven, with salvager Cassie looking for scrap around abandoned facilities. To get around, you have to use limited control of gravity to progress through various puzzle-like scenario rooms... Read more.

notes.title: All patched up
notes.content:
Now is the best time to try out the demo with a fresh new update! 

We have watched tons of gameplay videos and got good feedback from the discussions with you, the players. As a result, the first patch for the demo is here, fixing some nasty bugs. We're always happy to hear your thoughts, so feel free to contact us here on Steam community or on [url=https://discord.gg/F4VdXByBAX]Sky Beneath Discord[/url]. Thanks for all the input thus far. 

Now go test out the demo!

Hint: if you finished the demo already, there's a neat shortcut in the level selection menu to go practice Annie's challenge. See if you can beat your previous record and start practicing for the big leagues.

notes.title: Sky Beneath Demo is out right now!
notes.content:
Go try it out! You can download It right now from our store page. 

We still have a lot of development ahead for the full release later this year, but since the gravity mechanics are getting so much interest, we wanted to let you run on the ceiling and do your crazy stunts as soon as possible. 

If you have time from all the playing, join us in the developer streams here on Steam today and see some entirely scared devs for their first time in front of a camera.

Developer streams on 4th of May at:

7-7:30am PDT / 4-4:30pm CET / 5-5:30pm EEST

and

10-10:30am PDT / 7-7:30pm CET / 8-8:30pm EEST

Go give that gravity suit a spin!

notes.title: Sky Beneath Discord is Open!
notes.content:
We created this community to gather all the scavengers in one camp, where everyone can share their thoughts about the game. You can find out the latest news about the development and be part of it by signing up for the closed test and giving feedback on what to improve and what you would like to see in the game.

The developers are on the channel and eager to hear what you think about the game. You can also ask us what is going behind the scenes. We hope to create a friendly, open, and engaging community, correlating to the values of our company.

Welcome to the motley crew of scavengers! 

Join here:
[URL=https://discord.gg/F4VdXByBAX]https://discord.gg/F4VdXByBAX[/url]
